# Fixtures

`beacon_report_v1.json` holds the golden vectors for the beacon report wire format. It is generated by the firmware
repository (`MeshCore-beacon-client`), which owns the format, and must not be edited by hand.

- Source: `test/test_beacon_report/test_beacon_report.cpp`, firmware commit `55fe473a` (branch `beacon`).
- Regenerate by running that test with `BEACON_REPORT_VECTORS_OUT=<path>/beacon_report_v1.json` set, then copy the file
  here and update the commit above. When the report `version` byte changes, add a new fixture file for the new version
  and keep the old one while the old version is still decoded.
- `tests/test_wire.py` checks `src/beacon_base/wire.py` against it.
